canonical:
[Definition]
failregex = ^gateway denied user=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ from <HOST> port [0-9]+ source=[a-z]+$
ignoreregex = ^gateway denied user=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ from [0-9.]+ port [0-9]+ source=health$
alternate:
[Definition]
failregex = ^gateway (denied) user=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ from <HOST> port [0-9][0-9]* source=[a-z]+$
ignoreregex = ^gateway (denied) user=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ from [0-9.]+ port [0-9][0-9]* source=health$
